 ### Commits (10 on fix/apodex-audit-findings)

 Per-finding, each independently buildable, Conventional-Commit style:

 ┌───────────┬─────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │ Commit    │ Finding         │ What                                                                                  │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ db8b6f9ee │ RC-01 / SEC-04  │ Atomic, owner-only (0o600), race-free config writes via mutate()                      │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ 3e14769ae │ REL-01          │ Bounded reconnect wait — offline states surface & stop, never hang                    │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ a2080560d │ bonus           │ Registered missing JCODE_SHOW_BASH_OUTPUT env key (fixed a pre-existing failing test) │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ caccb0cd7 │ chore           │ .gitignore for .agents/ + .DS_Store                                                   │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ 99ec6f362 │ REL-02          │ Malformed config preserves last-good + backs up the corrupt file                      │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ a1365e9b0 │ A11Y-01 / VC-01 │ docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md; TUI now honors NO_COLOR/JCODE_NO_COLOR                         │
 ├───────────┼─────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ 678fbd59b │ SEC-07          │ SECURITY.md — honest install/update trust model + hardening roadmap                   │
 └───────────┴─────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

 ### Final verification (after a clean rm -rf target rebuild)

 Root jcode binary compiles ✅ · SEC-01 57, SEC-02 8, SEC-03 3, RC-01/SEC-04/REL-02 3, REL-01 4, VC-01 81 tests all pass · cargo fmt clean
 · clippy-clean on my code (the only 2 clippy warnings are in pre-existing code).

 ### Judgment calls I made (and why)

 - VC-01: implemented as a buffer-level NO_COLOR pass at the render chokepoint, not a new ColorCapability enum variant (which would ripple
 across two crates). Contrast is already asserted per the meta-audit — I documented the OKLab-vs-WCAG caveat rather than duplicating it.
 - SEC-07 & A11Y-01 --json-events: delivered as honest docs + a concrete roadmap. Signing-key custody and a structured event stream are
 maintainer-level decisions; a half-built signature scheme would be worse than none.
 - SEC-03 SearXNG: deliberately not blocked — it's operator-configured (often self-hosted on LAN), unlike the model-supplied webfetch URL.
